title: Segmentor
role: Type design, live visual tool, performance
intro:
Segmentor is an exploration of what playing drums and designing typefaces have in common, and what links could be brought forward.

During my year at [Type and Media](https://typemedia.org) in The Hague I combined both practices into a live visual tool that renders experimental typographic animations for any show I play. Every letter on this website is set in Segmentor.

Since then I have played live demos, such as the launch of De Situatie #2 at [PIP](https://www.pipdenhaag.nl) Den Haag (2025), and released a 100 x 70 cm six-colour silkscreen specimen poster (2026).

Segmentor won a [TDC72](https://tdc.org/?p=11807) Type High Gold Award (Type Design, Multiple Axis Type Family) and a Bronze at the [European Design Awards](https://www.kabk.nl/nieuws/type-media-alum-malin-neamtu-wins-european-design-award), both in 2026.
